description: This file defines vector data structures and associated operations for Spark MLlib, including dense and sparse vectors, with methods for creation, conversion, normalization, distance calculations, and vector algebra.

classes.name: Vector
classes.description: A sealed trait representing a numeric vector with methods for vector operations and conversions.

classes.name: DenseVector
classes.description: A class representing a dense vector backed by an array of doubles.

classes.name: SparseVector
classes.description: A class representing a sparse vector with index and value arrays.

methods.name: dense
methods.description: Factory method to create a dense vector from values.

methods.name: sparse
methods.description: Factory method to create a sparse vector from size, indices, and values.

methods.name: zeros
methods.description: Creates a zero vector of specified size.

methods.name: fromBreeze
methods.description: Creates a Spark vector from a Breeze vector.

methods.name: norm
methods.description: Computes the p-norm of a vector.

methods.name: sqdist
methods.description: Calculates squared distance between two vectors.
